memories.content: The Hiring Committee reviews applications and decides whom to interview. They have a standard process: applications received by a certain date are considered in the first round; later applications may be reviewed if time permits. They do not know Rosa personally.

Last spring, there was a job opening that required applications. Rosa submitted her application one week after the earliest possible date. The Hiring Committee received many applications and conducted interviews. The exact cutoff date for guaranteed consideration is not publicly known.
